keyPoints: Yuklid ke anusar bindu ka koi bhaag nahi, rekha chaudai-rahit lambai hai — paribhashaon se jyamiti shuru hoti hai.
Abhigrihit (axiom) bina siddh ke maane jaate hain — do binduon se ek hi rekha jaati hai — inhe siddh nahi kiya jaata, maana jaata hai.
Samantar rekhaon ko tiryak kaate to sangat kon, ekantar kon barabar aur sah-antar kon sampurak hote hain — aur iska vilom bhi satya hai — kon barabar hon to rekhaen samantar hoti hain.
Tribhuj ke teenon konon ka yog 180 hota hai — samantar rekha kheench kar siddh kiya jaata hai.
Bahya kon prameya: tribhuj ka bahya kon door ke dono antar konon ke yog ke barabar hota hai.
Prameya siddh karne me diya gaya tathya, siddh karna hai, aur rachna/siddhi ke charan spasht likho — chitra banana siddhi ka pehla kadam hai.
Aam galti: prameya ko udaaharan se siddh samajhna — ek naap ka sahi hona sab ke liye siddhi nahi hota.
subject: Maths
title: Rekhaen aur Kon: Prameya
